use_cases.name: Draft approved project summaries
approved_data: Approved internal project documents in the fictional pilot site
prohibited_data: Restricted client data and personnel records
use_cases.required_outcome: Reduce median first-draft time from 40 to 30 minutes while reviewers accept at least 9 of 10 drafts
use_cases.expand_stop_decision: Stop for a disclosure incident. Review quality, time and risk results with the sponsor before expanding.

pilot_scope.description: Ten fictional operations users, their managed devices and the approved internal project site
pilot_scope.evidence_reference: FICTIONAL-CHARTER-001: approved pilot population and content boundary

pilot_plan.baseline: Ten fictional sample documents required a median of 40 minutes per first draft; reviewers retained the quality rubric.

control_reviews.rationale: Fictional retention requirements and the applied policy were reviewed for the approved project site; the owner accepted coverage for this population.
control_reviews.evidence_reference: FICTIONAL-RETENTION-REVIEW-001: requirements and policy scope record

control_reviews.reviewer_role: Information protection owner and content owner
control_reviews.rationale: Fictional sensitive content in the pilot site was identified and its effective access was reviewed against the approved user list.
control_reviews.evidence_reference: FICTIONAL-ACCESS-REVIEW-001: reviewed sensitive content and access records

control_reviews.rationale: The fictional named pilot roster was checked against assigned Copilot licenses and required base licenses.
Two fictional pilot devices still require the approved application update before they can join the pilot.
control_reviews.evidence_reference: FICTIONAL-APP-REVIEW-001: reviewed device and application prerequisite inventory
